# TeleCrypt.io Storage SDK

> Library-only end-to-end encrypted file storage and sharing on Matrix. Install the exact public
> `@telecrypt-io/storage` version required by the consumer. This package provides no executable.

## Distribution boundary

`@telecrypt-io/storage@0.4.0` is the current library release. Install it as a project
dependency:

```bash
npm install @telecrypt-io/storage@0.4.0
```

Do not install it globally and do not expect a `telecrypt-io` command. The command-line client is
distributed separately.

The standalone command-line client is distributed only through exact GitHub Release archives from
`TeleCrypt-io/storage-cli`. The browser application is maintained in
`TeleCrypt-io/storage.telecrypt.io`.

## Library API

```ts
import { TeleCryptIOStorage } from "@telecrypt-io/storage";
import * as core from "@telecrypt-io/storage/core";

const storage = await TeleCryptIOStorage.create({
  baseUrl,
  userId,
  accessToken,
  deviceId,
});

const vault = await core.createVault(storage, "Photos");
await core.uploadFile(storage, vault.id, "cat.jpg", bytes, "image/jpeg");
```

Files are encrypted locally before upload; the server stores ciphertext. Sharing uses full Matrix
user IDs such as `@alice:example.org`. Recovery material and authenticated SDK state belong only in
the consuming application or authorized test environment—never in source, logs, fixtures, or
hosted CI secrets.

## Release policy

Library releases are immutable exact versions published from protected `v*` tags through NPM
Trusted Publishing/OIDC with provenance. Consumers must pin an exact version and publish their own
immutable release before deployment.
